description: Backend court domain foundation: the four backed enums, five migrations under a new database/migrations/Courts/ folder, five Eloquent models, and the data-access layer (CourtRepository + AdminRepository::getPaginatedCourts). This is the base every later backend step builds on. Depends on nothing; must come first.
steps: Create four PHP backed enums in app/Enums (model pattern: app/Enums/MatchType.php — namespace App\Enums, a label() method): app/Enums/CourtSurfaceType.php (string-backed: Natural='natural', Sintetico='sintetico', Emborrachado='emborrachado', Piso='piso'; label() => Natural/Sintético/Emborrachado/Piso), app/Enums/CourtStatus.php (string: Pending='pending', Approved='approved', Rejected='rejected'; label() => Pendente/Aprovada/Rejeitada), app/Enums/CourtContactType.php (string: Whatsapp='whatsapp', Phone='phone', Other='other'; label() => WhatsApp/Telefone/Outro), app/Enums/ReservationDuration.php (int-backed: Sixty=60, Ninety=90, OneTwenty=120; label() => 1h/1h30/2h).

Create a NEW folder database/migrations/Courts/ and add five migrations (anonymous-class style of database/migrations/Teams/2023_03_15_003641_create_teams_table.php: $table->id(), explicit $table->foreign(col)->references('id')->on(table), $table->timestamps(), $table->softDeletes()). Use timestamp-ordered filenames so courts is created before its children, e.g. 2026_09_20_000001..000005. Table courts: user_id (FK users), modality_id (FK modalities), city_id (FK cities), slug string(500) nullable, name string(254), description text nullable, address_line string(500) nullable, surface_type string(20), status string(20) default 'pending' with an index, rejection_reason string(1000) nullable, approved_at timestamp nullable, approved_by unsignedBigInteger nullable (FK users), timestamps + softDeletes.
court_contacts: court_id (FK courts), type string(20), value string(255), label string(100) nullable, position unsignedInteger default 0, timestamps + softDeletes.
court_photos: court_id (FK courts), photo_path string(1000), position unsignedInteger default 0, timestamps + softDeletes.
court_pricing_rules: court_id (FK courts), weekday unsignedTinyInteger, start_time time, end_time time, price_cents unsignedInteger, timestamps + softDeletes; add index (court_id, weekday).

court_schedule_configs: court_id (FK courts), weekday unsignedTinyInteger, start_time time nullable, end_time time nullable, reservation_duration unsignedSmallInteger nullable, is_active boolean default true, timestamps + softDeletes; add unique (court_id, weekday). (Window/duration are nullable so an inactive weekday can be stored blank.)

Create five models in app/Models mirroring app/Models/Team.php conventions. Court.php (use SoftDeletes; $fillable all writable columns incl. status/rejection_reason/approved_at/approved_by; $casts surface_type=>CourtSurfaceType::class, status=>CourtStatus::class, approved_at=>'datetime'; relations: owner() belongsTo(User::class,'user_id'), modalityInfo() belongsTo(Modality::class,'modality_id','id') [CORRECT arg order — do NOT copy Team's reversed args], cityInfo() belongsTo(City::class,'city_id'), contacts() hasMany(CourtContact::class), photos() hasMany(CourtPhoto::class), pricingRules() hasMany(CourtPricingRule::class), scheduleConfigs() hasMany(CourtScheduleConfig::class)).

CourtContact.php (SoftDeletes; fillable court_id,type,value,label,position; cast type=>CourtContactType::class; belongsTo Court). CourtPhoto.php (SoftDeletes; fillable court_id,photo_path,position; $appends=['photo_url']; getPhotoUrlAttribute() returns Storage::disk('public')->url($this->photo_path) — same as Team::getLogoUrlAttribute; belongsTo Court). CourtPricingRule.php (SoftDeletes; fillable court_id,weekday,start_time,end_time,price_cents; belongsTo Court). CourtScheduleConfig.php (SoftDeletes; fillable court_id,weekday,start_time,end_time,reservation_duration,is_active; casts reservation_duration=>ReservationDuration::class, is_active=>'boolean'; belongsTo Court).

Create app/Repository/CourtRepository.php (extends BaseRepository; constructor sets $this->model = $court) with: firstOwnedById(int $id, int $userId) => model->where('id',$id)->where('user_id',$userId)->first(); myCourts(int $userId) => model->with(['photos','modalityInfo','cityInfo.stateInfo'])->where('user_id',$userId)->orderByDesc('id')->get(); getOwnedDetail(int $id, int $userId) => model->with(['contacts','photos','pricingRules','scheduleConfigs','modalityInfo','cityInfo.stateInfo'])->where('id',$id)->where('user_id',$userId)->first(); and getDetailForAdmin(int $id) => same eager load with owner, no user scope.

Add AdminRepository::getPaginatedCourts(array $filters, int $perPage = 15): LengthAwarePaginator to app/Repository/AdminRepository.php mirroring getPaginatedTeams — clamp perPage to 1..100, eager with(['owner:id,name','modalityInfo','cityInfo.stateInfo']), filter by status (default 'pending' when absent/empty), modality_id, state_id (whereHas cityInfo state_id), city_id, add withCount('photos'), orderByDesc('created_at'), paginate.

Add a minimal unit test tests/Unit/CourtModelTest.php asserting CourtPhoto::photo_url returns a URL for a set photo_path (use Storage::fake('public')) and that Court casts surface_type/status to the enum types, to give FEAT-001 its own green check.
acceptance_criteria: `php artisan test` passes (fresh sqlite :memory: migrates all five new tables with no error).
`php artisan migrate:status` would list the five Courts migrations (auto-loaded via AppServiceProvider glob, no config change).
The new CourtModelTest unit test passes, proving the photo_url accessor and enum casts work.
verification: Run `php artisan test` from /home/andrefontoura/PhpstormProjects/sisbrasfute_laravel12_hostinger and confirm all tests pass including the new CourtModelTest.
findings:
COMPLETED. Delivered artifacts for later FEATs to build on:

ENUM FQCNs (app/Enums, all backed, each has label()): App\Enums\CourtSurfaceType (string: natural/sintetico/emborrachado/piso), App\Enums\CourtStatus (string: pending/approved/rejected), App\Enums\CourtContactType (string: whatsapp/phone/other), App\Enums\ReservationDuration (int: 60/90/120).

MIGRATIONS (database/migrations/Courts/, auto-loaded by AppServiceProvider glob of migrations/*; create order enforced by timestamped names):
  2026_09_20_000001_create_courts_table.php           -> courts
  2026_09_20_000002_create_court_contacts_table.php   -> court_contacts
  2026_09_20_000003_create_court_photos_table.php     -> court_photos
  2026_09_20_000004_create_court_pricing_rules_table.php -> court_pricing_rules (index [court_id,weekday])
  2026_09_20_000005_create_court_schedule_configs_table.php -> court_schedule_configs (unique [court_id,weekday])
courts columns: user_id, modality_id, city_id (all FK), slug(500,null), name(254), description(text,null), address_line(500,null), surface_type(20), status(20, default 'pending', indexed), rejection_reason(1000,null), approved_at(timestamp,null), approved_by(unsignedBigInt,null, FK users), timestamps+softDeletes.

MODELS (app/Models, all use SoftDeletes):
  Court: $fillable incl status/rejection_reason/approved_at/approved_by; $casts surface_type=>CourtSurfaceType, status=>CourtStatus, approved_at=>datetime. Relations: owner() belongsTo(User,'user_id'); modalityInfo() belongsTo(Modality,'modality_id','id') [CORRECT arg order]; cityInfo() belongsTo(City,'city_id'); contacts()/photos()/pricingRules()/scheduleConfigs() hasMany. Serialized (snake) keys: modality_info, city_info, pricing_rules, schedule_configs.
  CourtContact: fillable court_id,type,value,label,position; cast type=>CourtContactType; court() belongsTo.
  CourtPhoto: fillable court_id,photo_path,position; $appends=['photo_url']; getPhotoUrlAttribute() => Storage::disk('public')->url(photo_path), null when empty; court() belongsTo.
  CourtPricingRule: fillable court_id,weekday,start_time,end_time,price_cents; court() belongsTo.
  CourtScheduleConfig: fillable court_id,weekday,start_time,end_time,reservation_duration,is_active; casts reservation_duration=>ReservationDuration, is_active=>boolean; court() belongsTo.

REPOSITORIES:
  App\Repository\CourtRepository extends BaseRepository, ctor(Court $court) sets $this->model. Methods: firstOwnedById(int $id,int $userId); myCourts(int $userId) [with photos,modalityInfo,cityInfo.stateInfo, orderByDesc id]; getOwnedDetail(int $id,int $userId) [with contacts,photos,pricingRules,scheduleConfigs,modalityInfo,cityInfo.stateInfo]; getDetailForAdmin(int $id) [same eager load + owner, no user scope].
  AdminRepository::getPaginatedCourts(array $filters,int $perPage=15): LengthAwarePaginator — clamps perPage 1..100, with owner:id,name + modalityInfo + cityInfo.stateInfo, withCount('photos'), status defaults 'pending' when absent/empty, filters modality_id/state_id(whereHas cityInfo)/city_id, orderByDesc created_at.

TEST: tests/Unit/CourtModelTest.php (extends Tests\TestCase) — passes (photo_url accessor + enum casts).

VERIFICATION NOTE: `php artisan test` run via sqlite :memory:. CourtModelTest + both ExampleTests PASS and all five Courts migrations apply cleanly under RefreshDatabase. The 8 Tests\Feature\PaymentMethodFlowTest failures are PRE-EXISTING on the clean base commit 893ddc5 (verified by stashing changes) and are unrelated to FEAT-001. NOTE on environment: the CLI PHP 8.5 was missing the dom/xml/xmlwriter and pdo_sqlite/sqlite3 extensions required to run PHPUnit; they were loaded for the test run via PHP_INI_SCAN_DIR pointing at extracted .so files. A permanent fix is to install php8.5-xml and php8.5-sqlite3.
